meaning:
παντελής, -ές
(πᾶς, τέλος), [in LXX: 3Ma.7:16 A* ;]
all-complete, entire, perfect; εἰς τ. παντελές, completely, utterly: Luk.13:11, Heb.7:25 (where perhaps in temp. sense, finally; see MM, xviii).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years. She was bent over, and could in no way straighten herself up.
Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever to make intercession for them.
